properties.name: The user can trigger capture of what only the session holds, rather than relying on an agent remembering to
properties.statement:
Reasoning that exists only in a conversation must be capturable ON THE USER'S WORD, at any point, not only when an agent chooses to offer it. A discipline that depends on being remembered decays under load.

THE NEED, and it is the same argument the loop nudge rests on: measured over 46 sessions, skills are read once per 380 tool calls and four are never read at all. A capture that happens only when the agent thinks of it is a capture that stops happening exactly when a session gets busy — which is when the most is worth keeping.

It can fail independently: any design where capture is agent-initiated only breaks it, whatever skill exists.
